parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a structural sample-app marker that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplication of 'DebugMetricsProvider.measureMemoryUsage' in 'DebugHUD.swift' is the canonical pattern of a sample/example target re-implementing a utility locally to avoid a hard dependency on the 'DebugPanel' package. Consolidating the two would couple the WallpaperSampleApp build graph to DebugPanel, which is architecturally undesirable. No refactor is warranted.
